Subject: [Approval request] Elevated promo credits for OrbitAI PLG expansion

Team —

OrbitAI (PLG signup: Sam Tanner) has moved from trial to active evaluation quickly. They hit a usage inflection this week after onboarding a pilot team; we expect enterprise procurement conversations in Q3. Sam asked if we can extend a promotional credit package to accelerate the POC and lock in region-specific latency tests.

Summary ask:
- One-time promotional grant: $50,000 in service credits (usable over 6 months)
- Primary objective: ensure they can complete a 3-week latency/load test across 3 regions and run integration evals for 2 pilots
- Success metric to align on: >60% of tokens consumed by pilot + signed SOW/PO or formal commitment within 90 days

Why this matters:
- OrbitAI is a high-velocity PLG account with clear upsell motion to Dedicated capacity; our early benchmarks show they’ll drive consistent monthly committed spend if POC goes well.
- Competitors have offered short-term discounts; a credit package is cleaner operationally than custom pricing.

Attachments: credit_proposal_OrbitAI.pdf (proposal + milestones), OrbitAI_usage_report_Q2.csv (their usage pattern)

Requesting leadership sign-off to issue the full $50k as promotional credits, or guidance on staging (e.g., $25k now, $25k on milestone). Happy to set a quick 15-min sync.

Thanks,
Soojin

Marissa / Soojin —

From a finance perspective, promo credits are treated as contra-revenue and need to be tracked to the deal. $50k is material enough to require:
- GL tagging to the deal id (DEAL-2026-0213)
- An internal memo documenting approval authority and intended milestones (so we can support audit trails)
- Recommendation: staged issuance. Suggest 60% up-front ($30k) and 40% ($20k) released on achievement of the SOW/PO or the milestone you outlined.

Also, we should confirm: will the credits be applied to hosted usage only (yes/no)? If they move to Dedicated and we accept credits against infra, that has different recognition implications — flagging for legal.

If you can attach the HubSpot deal link and ensure the credit template is used on the account, I can approve the staged plan.

Thanks,

I reviewed the proposal and the usage report. OrbitAI looks like a reasonable strategic bet for the West Coast product motion. I’m comfortable providing conditional approval with these constraints:
- Issue $30,000 in promotional credits immediately (hosted-only)

- Add a 90-day conversion checkpoint: if no commitment or visible POC progress at 90 days, remaining credits void

Marissa, confirm you’ll own milestone verification and that the HubSpot deal is updated with the credit issuance and milestone language. Laura, please prepare the GL entries and memo template. Markus — please note for quotas/comp plan treatment.

If no objections by end of day, I give this exec clearance to proceed.
